onboarding.buyerOnly: This account already has a buyer business ({name}). To sell, please sign up for the seller app with a different email address. We will add a way to enable selling on an existing business soon.
onboarding.saveHint: Each step saves as you go. You can close this page and continue later.

s1.title: Tell us about your business
s1.body: Just the basics. Takes under a minute.

s2.title: Verify your phone
s2.body: This is your first verification level. It tells buyers you are a real person.

s3.title: Verify your GST
s3.body: Optional now, and it gives you the GST verified badge.

s4.title: Add your first listing
s4.body: Describe it the way you would on WhatsApp. AI drafts it, you check it.

s5.title: Plan and permissions
s5.body: Start free. Choose what we may do with your data.

gst.noGstBody: You can skip and start listing. You will show as Unverified (phone only), which buyers trust less, and you may rank lower than GST-verified sellers with similar listings. Verify any time from the Verification page.
gst.skip: I don't have GST yet, skip for now

listing.manual: I prefer to fill in a form

business.name: Business name
business.languages: Languages you talk to buyers in

phone.mobileHint: We send a one-time code by SMS. Buyers see your number only after you accept their lead.

plan.loadFail: Plans could not be loaded. You will start on the Free plan and can change it in Billing.
plan.credits: {count, plural, one {# lead credit per month} other {# lead credits per month}}
plan.note: Free is the default. Paid plans start only if you pick them here, last one month, and never renew on their own. Your badge and rank do not depend on your plan.
plan.dataHint: Tick only what you agree to. You can change these later in Settings.

errors.name: Enter your business name.
errors.code: Enter the code from the SMS.
errors.codeMismatch: That code did not match. Check it and try again.
errors.plan: Choose one of the plans shown.

done.title: You are all set, {name}
done.subtitle: Your seller account is ready. Here is what to do next.

leads.title: Watch for your first lead
leads.body: Leads that match your listings show up under Leads. You have 2 hours to accept or decline each one, and nothing is charged until you accept.

gst.title: Verify your GST
gst.body: Get the GST verified badge and rank higher with buyers.

listings.title: Add more listings
listings.body: Every extra product you list gives us more to match you with.
